question.value: What are the relative proper motions of 22 GHz H2O masers in NGC 6334I during the first year after the MM1 accretion burst, and what do they say about jets and outflows?

evidence.quote: We derive the relative proper motion measurements for these H$_2$O masers in order to probe the kinematics of the gas surrounding MM1 and MM3-UCHII in this region of active star formation.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2015.A.00022.T.

evidence.quote: The spectral resolution is 15.625 kHz ($\sim$0.21  km s$^{-1}$) for the H$_2$O maser line.
The rest frequency of the receiver was set to 22.235120 GHz.

analysis_steps.goal: Calibrate KaVA data and image maser spots

method.value: AIPS calibration, IMAGR/CLEAN, SAD Gaussian fits for spot positions

evidence.quote: The SAD task was employed for the Gaussian fitting for extraction of the peak intensities and offset positions of the maser spots.

method.value: Displacement of maser features between adjacent epochs, averaged for 3-epoch features, relative to a reference maser spot in UCHII-W1

evidence.quote: For features detected in all three epochs, the average of the proper motion between epochs 1 & 2, and epochs 2 & 3 were taken.
The overall uncertainty in our derived relative proper motions due to the motion of the reference maser spot is $<$ 10%.

validation.value: Compared with HartRAO single-dish spectra and VLA results

evidence.quote: This mean proper motion is in agreement with the previous results from VLA multi-epoch observations.

evidence.quote: The major axis is defined by the eigenvector corresponding to the largest eigenvalue.

findings_qualitative.value: Proper motions of CM2-W2, MM1-W1, MM1-W3 and UCHII-W3 are mostly driven by the MM1B radio jet; UCHII-W1 is likely driven by MM3-UCHII.

evidence.quote: Our results suggested that the motion of the UCHII-W1 H$_2$O maser group is largely driven by the expansion of MM3-UCHII .

claims.hypothesis: H2O maser proper motions after the burst trace jet-driven shocks
claims.experiment: 3-epoch KaVA proper motions plus VVCM analysis
claims.result: Mean 85 km/s; major axis PA -79.4 deg through MM1B cavity
claims.finding: Masers in CM2-W2 and others trace the MM1B jet

evidence.quote: Overall, the post-accretion burst relative proper motions of the H$_2$O masers trace shocks of jet motion.

claims.hypothesis: UCHII-W1 motions are driven by the MM1B jet
claims.experiment: Compared proper motion direction with jet axis
claims.result: UCHII-W1 moves northward, against the jet direction
claims.finding: Driven by MM3-UCHII rather than MM1B

evidence.quote: The relative proper motions of the H$_2$O masers in UCHII-W1 are likely not driven by the jets of MM1B protostar but by MM3-UCHII.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: OH maser magnetic field reversal as cause of UCHII-W1 northward motion, rejected as too distant

evidence.loc: 4.3 Impact of MM3-UCHII on UCHII-W1 maser spatio-kinematics
evidence.quote: therefore may not be responsible for the observed northward proper motions of UCHII-W1 masers

limitations_admitted.value: Complex maser distributions in MM1-W1 and UCHII-W1 may affect proper motions

evidence.quote: this complexity may have affected, in small measures, the derived proper motions

referee_caveats_inferred: Only three epochs spanning about 2 months
Relative proper motions depend on a reference maser that itself moves
ALMA data role unclear; only used as background image
